label: What a root's seated ESSENCE_6 condition excludes, its seat's determination REQUIRES_LACK_2 in it
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (TRANSFER_2, REQUIRES_LACK_2): the same as TRANSFER_1 with requirement in the root: where a seated condition of r's own nature fails at an admissible extension q of r's profile, some determination of r that its seat realizes requires, in r, the joint lack of some members of q. Its rationale is the identity thesis for a simple being (its one constituent is, in reality, each determination it realizes) together with closure of what belongs to a constituent under the exclusion a failing condition expresses. A simple root that lacks noesis by a clause of its one nature meets it, with its being, as realized in it, requiring the lack of noesis in it (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 3).
